reviews.comment: Mona is a fantastic professor! The class itself is very difficult, but she provides a lot of resources, and the homework is a great indicator of what will be on exams. She takes notes with the class during lecture, which is extremely helpful. Her canvas setup is also so organized and so well done. Additionally, she provides TONS of extra credit!

Mona is awesome! It was my first time taking her and I'm sad I wont have her as a professor again. Her canvas set up is a literal dream. The content is hard, just stay on top of studying and you wont have a problem. She takes notes in class which is super helpful as it is usually what she is testing you on specifically. Textbook helped a lot too.

She's a cool professor, but the course itself is very difficult. She does provide opportunities for extra credit and tutoring can be helpful. I think for this course she could've taught a bit differently than her BIOL 111 course, but it's okay. You definitely have to study for her exams, but overall they are pretty fair.

She never once dumbed anything down she struggle with this a lot and would compare her other classes in class like saying you learned this in my biology class. Never once could predict what was on her exams and would teach myself and study endlessly for them and still would do bad. You need to ask/answer questions in class due to it being graded
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Cares so much about her students and actually wants us to learn. Her lectures are both informative and entertaining. Very accessible outside class; all lectures are recorded and uploaded in case you can't attend. There's extra credit for just going to tutoring. I wish I could fit all my appreciation for her in the character limit.

Mona's class was a great intro to Bio! Her notes during class are super detailed and helpful for studying. Participation is required, but attendance is not. She holds review sessions before each test, which I found extremely helpful and there are weekly tutoring sessions for extra credit on test. She is super caring and easy to talk to!

Mona is actually a really good teacher. She's able to simplify complicated biological processes and also takes notes for students to use for studying. She's always giving opportunities for extra credit and bonus points towards exams. She does talk about her ex-husband a lot but okay.

Mona is a great instructor. The class is manageable. Go to group study for extra credit; it only meets once a week. Exams use LockDown Browser and are fair if you study. Homework is easy, and quizzes are open note and open web. Lab is fun, usually quick, and all lab quizzes and exams are open web and not monitored.
She is honestly amazing and so sweet. Please go to GGS, even if you have the bonus points for that week. She covers a lot, but her lectures are very fun.

Really great professor! She always gives 6+ extra credit points either from group studies or additional tasks on every test. She makes it very easy to learn. It will be challenging, but not too hard to get an A. As long as you start the lab off well, complete homework and quizzes on time, and study, you should at least get a B+ or higher.

She is very nice, and she gives good feedback on how to improve in her class. She will try her best to make sure you succeed in her class. Participation is 5% of your total grade. The TA I had for this  class was also great,and explained things clearly. Mona is the best Professor I've had while I've been at TAMUG.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Good professor. She is super sweet and caring. Tests are very full of info, but if you study then you are sure to do good. Participation in class is 5% and does help raise grade. Extra points on tests for going to group guided study and other things (helps out a lot). Lots of dissections in labs. Overall not too bad if you put forth the effort.

Mona is a great professor. She will do anything to make sure you do well in her class. She gives good feedback on what you did wrong and how you can improve. You are graded on participation which is 5% of your grade. She is the best professor I have had while at TAMUG.

Mona is an amazing biology teacher. There are so many helpful extra credit opportunities she offers. She also has review sessions before the tests on Sundays and guided group studies that you can get up to 6 points extra on the test for attending. Mona actually cares for her students so much. I feel like I learned so much in this class.

I love Mona. Best Prof I have ever had and she genuinely loves her students and job. She inserts her personal ideologies every now and then which is either great or terrible depending on if you agree with her or not. Regardless, she is wonderful and would 100% recommend her.
Very nice professor, she will do anything to make sure you succeed in her class. Lectures are organized neatly and easy to understand.

Lectures are organized and entertaining. She will go out of her way to help you if you are struggling with the class. Gives great feedback on how you can improve your test grade/overall grade. 
Class precipitation is 10% of overall grade, each question you ask in class adds to that overall grade at the end of semester.

Lectures were very engaging and funny, pay attention bc she uses info from lectures in quizzes and tests.

She was also very accessible outside of class, and is happy to help you in any way if you send her an email! 

She was amazing, I highly recommend taking her class!!!

Only complaint is class content doesn't match with lab activities, but lab is fun and its "own thing" kinda. Great teacher, caring, gives opportunities to succeed, and responsive. She personally held study sessions before tests when asked (unheard of!!). Do the work, STUDY, get test feedback, ask questions, participate in class, and you'll do fine.

Mona is by far the best professor on this campus. Literally the most caring prof I ever seen. Her exams are not easy but with a good studying habit and paying attention in class you will be fine. She offers exam review before every exam which makes a huge difference in understanding everything. She also has exam topics so you know what to study for

Mona is the best prof for a science class. There is a lot of work but it's not hard. There is a quiz in almost every lecture but it's open note and open peer, and she drops three of the lowest grades for quizzes. Ppl stop going because she drops 3, don't make that mistake. Participate and do the practice problems. She curves tests, and extra credit

I love Mona!!! She is a great professor and will give you clear feedback on anything you missed or don't understand. She also is a great resource for later years when you need reccomendations. I highly recommend taking her!

Mona is the best professor I have taken thus far. She is very caring and goes out of her way to ensure her students are succeeding. Once we moved to the online format she emailed us her phone number so we could contact her quickly if need be. In addition to this she offered us rides back home since some students dont have a car. She is a saint!
Amazing lecturer. Very engaging and cares about her students truly learning.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I love how interesting and interactive her lecturers are. She post practice problems for the test and if you study them you will do well on the test.

Professor Hochman is the BEST prof ever!! Not only does she really understand what she is teaching, but she knows how to teach and help others understand. She knows everyone by name and always has extra credit opportunities. She cares about the students on a personal level and is a genuine person. Tests are easy if you pay attention in class. 10/10
Very knowledgeable about the subject but had difficulty breaking it down into digestible pieces for an introductory course. Normally teaches BIOL 351.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY
